Hi Marta / AP Team,

Following up on invoice INV-2026-1147 (due 2025-09-30). We haven’t received remittance yet and wanted to confirm the easiest path for Acme to settle. Options we can accept right now: ACH (domestic), wire (USD), or virtual card. If card is preferred we can take the payment now and then issue a remittance confirmation; if ACH/wire, please let us know the expected value date so we can reconcile.

Two items that will help speed this through:
- Can you confirm which legal entity will be remitting (Acme IoT, Inc. US or Acme IoT Ltd. EU)? That determines VAT/tax treatment and whether we need a VAT/residency certificate.
- The PO number on our invoice is INV-PO-1147 but AP’s remittance preview shows PO 1148 — can you confirm the right PO to avoid a mismatch hold?

I’ve attached the invoice and our wire instruction PDF. If you want to pay by card, reply and we’ll send a secure link (or we can process via your procurement card on file). If you want us to accept a partial card payment today and wire the remainder, we can accept that as well — confirm amounts and timing.

Thanks — short on time today so appreciate a quick reply.

Best,
